paragraphs.source_en: On the fourth day of the eighth month in the fifth year of Keichō, Tokugawa Ieyasu left Oyama for Edo, where he rested at Edo Castle.

units.source_en: On the fourth day of the eighth month in the fifth year of Keichō, Tokugawa Ieyasu left Oyama for Edo, where he rested at Edo Castle.
units.source_zh: 庆长五年八月初四，德川家康从小山出发前往江户，然后在江户城休整。

paragraphs.source_zh: 庆长五年八月初四，德川家康从小山出发前往江户，然后在江户城休整。

paragraphs.source_en: Before departing, Ieyasu left Torii Shintarō Tadamasa with Yūki Hideyasu. Everyone assumed that Ieyasu had left Shintarō behind because leaving Gamō Hideyuki and Ogasawara Hidemasa alone had not set his mind at ease. Only on the third day after reaching Edo did they understand the truth.

units.source_en: Before departing, Ieyasu left Torii Shintarō Tadamasa with Yūki Hideyasu.

units.source_en: Everyone assumed that Ieyasu had left Shintarō behind because leaving Gamō Hideyuki and Ogasawara Hidemasa alone had not set his mind at ease. Only on the third day after reaching Edo did they understand the truth.
units.source_zh: 众人都以为，家康把蒲生秀行和小笠原秀政留下还不放心，才把新太郎留下，可到达江户第三日，众人才明白过来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 临出发前，家康将鸟居新太郎忠政留在了结城秀康身边。众人都以为，家康把蒲生秀行和小笠原秀政留下还不放心，才把新太郎留下，可到达江户第三日，众人才明白过来。

paragraphs.source_en: “What has happened?” Honda Masanobu, who did not know what the letter contained, asked the question.

units.source_zh: “发生了何事？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “发生了何事？”本多正信并不知书函内容，问道。

paragraphs.source_en: “Fushimi Castle fell on the first day of the eighth month.” His eyes brimming with tears, Ieyasu dropped these few words and hurried away. Everyone understood at once that some calamity must have befallen Torii Mototada, and that Ieyasu had meant to preserve Shintarō’s life.

units.source_en: “Fushimi Castle fell on the first day of the eighth month.”
units.source_zh: “八月初一，伏见城陷落。”

units.source_en: His eyes brimming with tears, Ieyasu dropped these few words and hurried away.

paragraphs.source_en: “Then His Lordship foresaw that no great battle would take place in Aizu, and that is why…” Bokusai said.

paragraphs.source_en: Bokusai and Zen’ami were not alone in thinking so; Honda Masanobu believed the same. They all believed that a towering blaze of anger had already kindled deep within Ieyasu’s tranquil heart.

units.source_zh: 大家都认为，家康沉静的心底，已燃起熊熊怒火。

paragraphs.source_zh: 不仅卜斋和全阿弥这么想，本多正信也这样认为。大家都认为，家康沉静的心底，已燃起熊熊怒火。

paragraphs.source_en: Meanwhile, the former Toyotomi retainers who had set out ahead from Oyama had crossed Suruga and were advancing from Tōtōmi toward eastern Mikawa.

units.source_en: Meanwhile, the former Toyotomi retainers who had set out ahead from Oyama had crossed Suruga and were advancing from Tōtōmi toward eastern Mikawa.
units.source_zh: 此时，从小山先行出发的丰臣旧臣已穿越骏河，正从远江向东三河进发。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时，从小山先行出发的丰臣旧臣已穿越骏河，正从远江向东三河进发。

paragraphs.source_en: Fushimi had fallen, the situation was dire, and not a moment could be lost. Ishida Mitsunari would plainly press his advantage, advancing from Ōmi into Mino. The Tokugawa host, too, stood like a bow drawn taut, while Honda Tadakatsu and Ii Naomasa were marching west—the clash of the two armies was imminent! So Ieyasu’s close attendants believed.

units.source_en: Fushimi had fallen, the situation was dire, and not a moment could be lost. Ishida Mitsunari would plainly press his advantage, advancing from Ōmi into Mino.
units.source_zh: 伏见陷落，形势危急，刻不容缓，很明显，石田三成必然会乘胜而进，从近江进入美浓。

units.source_en: The Tokugawa host, too, stood like a bow drawn taut, while Honda Tadakatsu and Ii Naomasa were marching west—the clash of the two armies was imminent!
units.source_zh: 德川家的大队人马也已弓满弦张，本多忠胜和井伊直政正在西进——两军大战一触即发！

units.source_en: So Ieyasu’s close attendants believed.
units.source_zh: 近臣们都这么想。

paragraphs.source_zh: 伏见陷落，形势危急，刻不容缓，很明显，石田三成必然会乘胜而进，从近江进入美浓。德川家的大队人马也已弓满弦张，本多忠胜和井伊直政正在西进——两军大战一触即发！近臣们都这么想。

paragraphs.source_en: Unexpectedly, Ieyasu soon wiped away his tears and returned to the kitchen quarters without saying a word about marching west. Nor did he betray the slightest emotion when he later learned that the former Toyotomi commanders had reached Fukushima Masanori’s castle at Kiyosu and that Oda Nobukatsu at Gifu had gone over to the enemy.

units.source_en: Unexpectedly, Ieyasu soon wiped away his tears and returned to the kitchen quarters without saying a word about marching west.
units.source_zh: 出人意料，家康未几便擦干眼泪回到了厨下，片言不提西进之事。

units.source_en: Nor did he betray the slightest emotion when he later learned that the former Toyotomi commanders had reached Fukushima Masanori’s castle at Kiyosu and that Oda Nobukatsu at Gifu had gone over to the enemy.
units.source_zh: 不仅如此，后来得知丰臣旧将已抵清洲福岛正则的城池、岐阜的织田信雄已投靠敌人时，家康亦丝毫不动声色。

paragraphs.source_zh: 出人意料，家康未几便擦干眼泪回到了厨下，片言不提西进之事。不仅如此，后来得知丰臣旧将已抵清洲福岛正则的城池、岐阜的织田信雄已投靠敌人时，家康亦丝毫不动声色。

paragraphs.source_en: Kiyosu repeatedly sent men urging Ieyasu to come west, but he remained immovable. Those around him speculated endlessly about his intentions. Though all firmly believed their lord had some brilliant stratagem in reserve, they could not help growing anxious as the enemy drew steadily nearer.

units.source_en: Kiyosu repeatedly sent men urging Ieyasu to come west, but he remained immovable.
units.source_zh: 清洲数次派人催促家康西上，但家康岿然不动。

units.source_en: Those around him speculated endlessly about his intentions. Though all firmly believed their lord had some brilliant stratagem in reserve, they could not help growing anxious as the enemy drew steadily nearer.

paragraphs.source_zh: 清洲数次派人催促家康西上，但家康岿然不动。身边人皆纷纷猜测家康心事，虽都坚信主公定有锦囊妙计，但眼看敌人步步逼近，不禁焦虑不已。

paragraphs.source_en: “It seems His Lordship considers Uesugi a greater concern than Ishida.”

paragraphs.source_en: “What has that to do with the matter before us?”

paragraphs.source_en: There was no denying that although everyone firmly believed Ieyasu had an extraordinary plan, they were all eager to march west. At last the middle of the eighth month arrived, yet Ieyasu remained unhurried, declaring instead that he had caught a chill and could not march west for the present.

units.source_en: There was no denying that although everyone firmly believed Ieyasu had an extraordinary plan, they were all eager to march west.

units.source_en: At last the middle of the eighth month arrived, yet Ieyasu remained unhurried, declaring instead that he had caught a chill and could not march west for the present.
units.source_zh: 时日终于到了八月中旬，但家康依然不急不躁，反而称染上了风寒，眼下不能西进。

paragraphs.source_zh: 不可否认，尽管众人都深信家康有非凡妙计，但都急于西进。时日终于到了八月中旬，但家康依然不急不躁，反而称染上了风寒，眼下不能西进。

paragraphs.source_en: In truth, Ieyasu had thought all of this through with great care. At first, he had intended to stay in Edo for only a night or two and then march west at once; every arrangement had already been made. But on the road back from Oyama to Edo, Ieyasu suddenly changed his mind.

paragraphs.source_en: It is said that while hurrying to Oyama, Ieyasu discovered that he had forgotten his command standard. Fearing the effect on morale, he fashioned one with his own hands near Kurihashi. On the return journey, the standard in his hand seemed to stir some thought within him.

units.source_en: It is said that while hurrying to Oyama, Ieyasu discovered that he had forgotten his command standard. Fearing the effect on morale, he fashioned one with his own hands near Kurihashi.

paragraphs.source_en: One might even say that the present upheaval had its origins in the second invasion of Korea. Discord divided not only the warriors themselves; the civil and military factions were also at daggers drawn. There had also been concealed reports of battlefield achievements and confused rewards and punishments. All of this had finally dragged the late Taikō’s life’s work into the mire of factional strife…

paragraphs.source_en: The “master of the command standard” could no longer be Ieyasu as an individual. It had to be the will of all the people beneath heaven who yearned for peace, the mighty current driving the age forward. Even if Ieyasu should unexpectedly fall along the way, that will must remain untouched, continuing to guide the great current of events and to wave its invisible command standard…

paragraphs.source_en: Having grasped this truth, Ieyasu ceased to hurry into the field and instead dispatched Murakoshi Mosuke Naoyoshi as an envoy to Kiyosu on the fourteenth day of the eighth month.
